items: 【Widened Solid Wood Base for Superior Stability】 This walnut brown coat rack freestanding features a widened solid wood base, crafted to give your home both stability and style. It’s more than a coat tree—it’s a warm welcome the moment you step inside. The wide base also fits 2 pairs of shoes, keeping your entryway neat and inviting. Whether you use it as a wood clothing rack, coat stand, or clothes tree by the door, it quietly supports your daily routines with the reliability you can feel.

【Double-Layer Storage & Multi-Purpose Organization】Designed for real, everyday living, this wood clothes rack adds calm and order to busy spaces. Two sturdy shelves and five hooks help you organize clothes, scarves, hats, bags, and shoes—everything that often gets tossed onto chairs. With a 50 lb capacity, it works beautifully as a small clothing rack,or small garment rack. No matter how hectic life gets, this coat rack with shelves keeps your essentials in one place, ready for your next day.

【Hidden Silent 360° Wheels for Easy Mobility】 Life changes quickly—your furniture should keep up. The hidden 360° silent wheels allow this coat tree freestanding to glide effortlessly across the room, whether you're cleaning, rearranging, or just finding the perfect spot. When tucked away, the wheels maintain the clean look of a wooden coat rack standing. Use it as a free standing coat rack, freestanding clothes racks, or clothes stand to bring flexibility and ease to your home.

【Durable 100% Solid Rubberwood Construction】 Made from premium FAS rubberwood, this solid wood clothing rack brings natural warmth into your space. The smooth lines and rich grain make it more than a heavy duty coat rack—it’s a piece that adds character and coziness. Whether placed in your bedroom, entryway, or living room, it stands strong as a coat rack wood, solid wood coat rack freestanding, clothing rack wood, or clothes tree for bedroom.

【Fast Assembly & Support You Can Trust】 You don’t need to be handy to put this clothes rack, coat tree, or hanging rack together—just 15 minutes and the included tools are all it takes. We’re here when you need us, offering 24-hour support through the Amazon Message Center. We believe good furniture should feel like a small kindness in your day—reliable, beautiful, and made to make life easier. From valet stands to hall tree coat racks, we create pieces that bring comfort and joy to your home.
